g.text: Command: "trigger this job" becomes an object, not a call
The Scheduler never calls the Worker directly -- it hands the queue a self-contained object instead.
a self-contained object, not a method call
A failed delivery just means the SAME command object gets redelivered from the queue and re-executed -- idempotencyKey
makes that safe. The Worker never needed the Scheduler alive, or even to still exist, to retry the job.
